patthana23.40:1.1: vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho sukhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassana
patthana23.40:2.1: sappaṭighaṃ na dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho dukkhāya vedanāya sampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
